replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Eh, when I record I get around 10 fps, so I will try to explain you.
As it was before the update, when you place blocks really fast or bridge, or sprint on a wall using fast block placing, the blocks dissapeare due to the anti-cheat. Also, when you break a monument sometimes it does not account and the monument re-appears, and you need to break it twice or more times for it to count. 
Also, sometimes random users become invisible and you cannot see them, however, they are able to kill you but their team-mates don't see them too.
Another issue is the TAB issue, when you press TAB some names are in random colors that aren't the colors of the teams in-game.
As for the biased knockback and biased reach and hit detection, I guess it's 1.8, if you can do something about that I guess the community will be really glad.

replies.author: Alpapi
replies.body:
The developers and owners were literally asking for their servers death wish by forcing the players to use 1.8, and the excuse why they did it, "Every server can't stay 1.7 forever", is pathetic, unreasonable, and highly counter-arguable.

Although the statement is in some cases true, there are good reasons that 90% of servers AREN'T using it. I generally hope that everyone notices how the daily number count of people online a day has dropped from 200+, to around 80-100.

Block lag, general lag, failure to register hits, fps lag, etc. There literally couldn't be a much worse situation to make the experience on Avicus worse on 1.8.

You threw in a new hub with some extra things with it. Yay... wow... now I can play on the laggy game servers and have a poor time getting things that really aren't all very worth it and that we've all pretty much seen before.

Mistakes have been made, and hopefully you know that by the amount of complaints. Not just on the forums, but in game. The whole, "Servers can't stay 1.8", can't last forever, and that excuse died out a while ago.

For the people that say, "You need to get used to it". Try very hard to understand that it is near impossible to play if you can't hit people, place blocks, or break blocks, and not forgetting to mention: The lag that 1.8 presumes to bring.

Maybe changes can be made, maybe not. Until changes are made, I don't expect anything better to come out of the server.
